$comment: Temporary, justified acceptances for `npm audit` high/critical findings in the
admin UI. Enforced by scripts/npm-audit-gate.sh — see that script for the rules.
An entry is only legitimate when the advisory is provably not exploitable in
this codebase AND no non-breaking patched version exists yet. Always prefer
upgrading. Every entry MUST carry a reason and a near-term `expires` date; the
gate fails once that date passes, so nothing can be quietly forgotten.
